objective: Season 2 KL reader-first dashboard and full admin-to-reader series preparation without changing live Season 1 or authorizing an OTA
environment: DEV only — no Main merge, staging/backend deployment, production OTA or paid build
releaseTarget: Reconcile into Season 2 DEV consolidation only after source/typecheck + isolated PostgreSQL role/progression tests. Do not activate before December 6, 2026 Manila time.
preserveBehaviors: Season 1 legacy reader and existing released chapter view remains available under Dashboard->Series 1
Current KL approval/rejection, private media, manuscript, 5-question readiness and server release RPC remain authoritative
Non-admins only see released chapters and released series metadata; private descriptions never exposed for draft-only series
Reader progress is per authenticated account; failed progress queries cannot grant locked chapter access
Season 2 chapter sequencing stays server-side; old clients cannot bypass chapter locks
Advertisements, navigation, Wall, Connect, economy, original native runtime and production credentials unchanged
Season 2 series release remains held until verified activation and independent backend QA
requiredVerification: Focused source contracts + full TypeScript on branch
Staging PostgreSQL migration/RLS and anon/other-member/admin RPC authorization checks
Draft-only series invisibility; first released chapter exposure; updates/rollback behavior
Series 1 reader parity, Series 2 server lock and quiz 3/3, offline/weak-network account switch
Exact runtime/RC fingerprints and ad/nav regression gates before any authorized publish
knownBlockers: No isolated Supabase staging DB verified
No Android device or real migration execution performed

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Change KL entry to reader dashboard, preserve existing Season 1, introduce series-filtered chapters and an admin publisher interface.
preservedBehaviors: Current Season 1 released reader and original admin approval, quiz, media and audio flow remain available
No existing AdMob, Wall, Connect, native, or non-KL app screens are altered

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add secure private editorial series metadata and a released-only public read catalog while preserving authorizations.
preservedBehaviors: Drafts, unapproved series, unpublished manuscripts and private media never reach the public series catalog
Admin-only table/RPC access remains active-system-admin role checked
Existing Season 2 sequential server progression and migration hold remain unchanged

productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only Supabase MAIN metadata inspection on 2026-11-23 confirmed kl_episodes uses season_number, chapter release gates and no Season 2 series metadata table; no staging branches were available. Production OTA remains unchanged.
chosenApproach: Add private admin-owned series metadata, a released-only public series catalog, an accessible series-first KL home and a per-series publisher release preflight. Preserve legacy Season 1 reader, dynamic story reader, existing authoritative publish/quiz RPCs and all production gates.
selectionRationale: Pure chapter-first navigation cannot show new series coherently; a client-maintained series catalog would leak draft descriptions or stale access. Server-verified published series with a protected admin metadata table avoids that risk.
acceptanceChecks: KL opens the dashboard before chapter listings; a reader can choose Season 1 or future released seasons
Dashboard shows per-account progress, continue-reading and only already released series
Admin can create private series title/description, create chapters, review media/quiz and publish via existing server authority
New series never appears on public catalog until a released/approved chapter exists
Old APK and direct RPC cannot bypass Season 2 chapter progression or earlier chapter completion
Source TypeScript, focused tests and mandatory repository scope gates pass
Do not apply schema, staging OTA, prod OTA or Android build before independently verified staging backend QA
alternativeApproaches: Client-only series list metadata (rejected: drafts could leak; no server publication evidence)
Replace original Season 1 reader with a new runtime (rejected: unnecessary risk to released prose/media/audio)
Add a separate new-series reader without a common dashboard (rejected: confusing entry and no progress overview)
